newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro-MPs endorse EU aid for population programmes.
newsitem.headline: Euro-MPs endorse EU aid for population programmes.

text.p: The European Parliament on Thursday approved European Union plans to support population programmes in the developing countries -- COM(95)295.
Euro-MPs endorsed the provisional decision of EU development ministers to provide 300 million Ecus for population programmes between now and the year 2000.
The world's poorest countries will be the main beneficiaries of the aid, which will concentrate on educating people about birth control and provide propoer health care.
Euro-MPs have insisted EU money should only support countries which allow people free choice over the number of children they have.
